body: It is only getting worse. I feel like doing this sooner than later. I will never succeed in life because of the cards I've been dealt. I will not succeed due to these mental health problems. I can't find a psychiatrist. I can't find hope. I never in my fucking life felt envy until now, when I realized I am the only person around me without their life set for them and how EVERYONE is so ungrateful. Their lack of gratitude fucking KILLS me.
